name: Veridu
tagline: Verify Cline's code change before you commit it
description: Veridu checks a code change before it is committed. Cline sends the diff and the changed files with verify_change; independent reviewers check it and return pass, review or block, with findings that give the file, line, severity and evidence. Follow-up checks after a fix say which findings persist and which are new. Also reviews GitHub pull requests. Sign in with OAuth; the free plan includes up to 20 reviews a month.
